objective: Prove a deterministic Android-to-debug-APK pipeline from an immutable Git commit without introducing AI engineering invocation.
acceptance: A minimal legitimate Android application builds on GitHub-hosted CI.
The Gradle wrapper and distribution are integrity-bound to published SHA-256 checksums.
CI runs unit tests before assembling the debug APK.
The produced debug APK exists and is bound by evidence to the exact workflow Git SHA.
APK package metadata is readable and matches com.melsuhaimi.sleepapp.bootstrap.
The verified APK and machine-readable verification evidence are uploaded as workflow artifacts.
A deliberately broken Android build is demonstrated to fail CI and cannot produce a VERIFIED result.
No OpenAI API or AI engineering invocation is introduced in Checkpoint 2.
